title: Custom-token mint in the legacy layout [mint, admin, to] after a BLND deposit (no fee bump)
why: A second contract with the pre-CAP-67 SEP-41 mint layout [mint, admin, to] in a plain (not fee-bumped) transaction: GBY2Q24L… deposits BLND and the contract CASYAKK3… mints its own token to it, naming itself as admin. Readers that apply the SAC three-topic layout to every mint credit the contract and lose the recipient.
notes: Apply index 187 of 294; envelope stage 0, cluster 0, position 7. GBY2Q24L… pays the fee (42992, refunded 10304) and transfers 1000000000000 BLND (trustline 2008102981009 → 1008102981009) to CASYAKK3…, which mints 1028706623 to it. The BLND Stellar Asset Contract CD25MNVT… (derived.contracts) stores CASYAKK3…'s balance and an allowance in its own contract data. Written live by stellar-core 29.0.0.
